description: This file implements Diffie-Hellman key generation and derivation functions, including Netflix-specific DH secret derivation, for cryptographic operations within a security module. It defines functions for generating key pairs and deriving shared secrets, and references external cryptography and vault management headers.

methods.name: GenerateDiffieHellmanKeys
methods.description: Generates a Diffie-Hellman key pair (public and private keys) using specified generator and modulus, and stores the keys in the vault, returning their IDs.

methods.name: DiffieHellmanAuthenticatedDeriveSecret
methods.description: Derives shared secrets (encryption, HMAC, wrapping keys) using Netflix-specific DH derivation, given private and peer public key IDs, and stores the derived keys in the vault.

methods.name: diffiehellman_generate
methods.description: Externally accessible function to generate DH key pair, calling internal implementation.

methods.name: diffiehellman_derive
methods.description: Externally accessible function placeholder for deriving shared secret, currently not implemented.

methods.name: netflix_security_derive_keys
methods.description: Externally accessible function to derive Netflix-specific security keys from DH key IDs.
